A smartgun with a unique voice-over interface. Slightly unpredictable. Bum bum be-dum bum bum be-dum bum…

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Auto-Compensator, Biometric Lock, Pistol Autosear, Smart Rebuild (w/ Advanced Smartlink) • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Improved Smart Ammunition. When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. If there are not 3 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine and deals 1d6 less damage (2d6). When firing this weapon, if the user rolls a Critical Failure (1) during their Attack Check, they do not roll an implosion d10 [Advanced Smartlink].

When first acquired, this weapon must be set to one of two different modes: Puppy-Loving Pacifist or Stone Cold Killer.

Puppy Loving Pacifist provides the user a +2 bonus to Leg and Held Item Aimed Shots, and disables making Head Aimed Shots with this weapon.

Stone Cold Killer provides this user a +2 bonus to Head Aimed Shots, and disables making Leg and Held Item Aimed Shots with this weapon.

Once a mode is selected, it cannot be changed for a month or until the primary user linked to this weapon’s Biometric Lock dies.

In addition, this weapon has a prototype on-board assistant which interacts with the user like a personalized Agent SAAI. At the GM’s discretion, this assistant may act of its own accord or otherwise malfunction in penalizing ways, such as firing this weapon of its own accord, incurring a -2 to all Attack checks with this weapon for an encounter, speaking loudly during a stealth-focused scene, and so on.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Auto-Compensator, Biometric Lock, Pistol Autosear, Smart Rebuild (w/ Advanced Smartlink) (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
